name: npm registry
tier_rationale: Established company (npm, Inc., part of GitHub/Microsoft) with published terms (A8): 'Registry: npm (GitHub), PyPI (PSF), DEV/Forem and Hugging Face tier trusted' (P100 cond 8); 'Registry: GitHub, GitLab, npm, PyPI and Docker trusted' (P359 cond 9).

reliability.justification: Authoritative registry metadata for npm packages; maintainer names and e-mails are self-asserted by publishers.

registry.title: npm registry API (package metadata, -/v1/search maintainer queries)

terms.quote: Registry: npm (GitHub), PyPI (PSF), DEV/Forem and Hugging Face tier trusted, Codeberg e.V. community; all terms open; personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8).

registry.notes: Research C0242 terms 'npm ToS (public metadata)' (limits undocumented; light use). Endpoints registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=maintainer:{u} (200 with total=0 = ABSENT) and registry.npmjs.org/{package} (P100 cond 3); never www.npmjs.com/~{u} (Client Challenge = BLOCKED reason challenge, P100 cond 4). Also 'open' for org_code_footprint: 'Sources: GitHub REST 'key-terms' (as P111); GitLab, Codeberg, npm, PyPI and Docker Hub 'open'.' (P359 cond 9). Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8). Used by dev_profiles_pack and org_code_footprint.

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G05-1 and p2-G05-2 (P100, P359): one client shared by both. Limits undocumented: no quota block.
